commands.name: /brain-brief
commands.use_when: after intake, research, and grill have enough signal
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-brief to a native command
commands.stop_condition: target user, decision owner, or success metric for the brief is unnamed

commands.name: /brain-build
commands.use_when: an implementation plan has a selected task and validation method
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-build to a native command
commands.stop_condition: implementation slice is not approved or lacks acceptance checks

commands.name: /brain-design
commands.use_when: a product brief needs ux or interaction design before planning
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-design to a native command
commands.stop_condition: user, scenario, constraints, or non-goals are missing

commands.name: /brain-eval
commands.use_when: changing Agent Brain behavior or checking quality
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-eval to a native command
commands.stop_condition: eval target, rubric, fixture, or expected behavior is undefined

commands.name: /brain-grill
commands.use_when: the idea, brief, design, or plan has unresolved assumptions
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-grill to a native command
commands.stop_condition: code/docs cannot answer a blocking question and the user is unavailable

commands.name: /brain-learn
commands.use_when: after repeated success/failure, a tricky fix, or a shipped workflow
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-learn to a native command
commands.stop_condition: lesson is temporary task state rather than durable project behavior

commands.name: /brain-plan
commands.use_when: the brief/design is strong enough to implement
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-plan to a native command
commands.stop_condition: objectives, constraints, owner, or acceptance criteria are not defined

commands.name: /brain-research
commands.use_when: the decision depends on external evidence or unfamiliar domain context
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-research to a native command
commands.stop_condition: claim cannot be grounded in primary or authoritative evidence

commands.name: /brain-review
commands.use_when: after verification or before public/shipping decisions
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-review to a native command
commands.stop_condition: diff, artifact, or intended behavior is unavailable

commands.name: /brain-ship
commands.use_when: a reviewed artifact is ready for release or publication
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-ship to a native command
commands.stop_condition: validation, review, rollback, monitoring, or ownership evidence is missing

commands.name: /brain-should-this-exist
commands.use_when: before planning any new product, feature, workflow, or automation
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-should-this-exist to a native command
commands.stop_condition: target user, repeated job, or non-agent baseline is not concrete

commands.name: /brain-start
commands.use_when: a user starts from a vague request, idea, task, or product ambition
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-start to a native command
commands.stop_condition: request lacks enough context to choose an initial state or command

commands.name: /brain-verify
commands.use_when: after build or when evaluating an existing artifact
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-verify to a native command
commands.stop_condition: artifact under test, expected behavior, or verification command is missing

commands.name: /brain-wiki
commands.use_when: ingesting sources or updating durable project knowledge
commands.native_support: markdown spec unless runtime maps /brain-wiki to a native command
commands.stop_condition: proposed wiki fact lacks a stable source, owner, or freshness date
